channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Advice for parents from teachers as kids prepare to head back to school
item.description: Good Morning Tampa Bay anchor Deiah Riley asked her sister, who is a teacher, what she and her colleagues wish every child would practice before walking back into the classroom.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] First on Scripps News: New Mexico files lawsuit accusing DOJ of withholding Epstein records
item.description: The New Mexico Department of Justice has filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Justice, accusing the agency of failing to comply with records requests related to Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] SpaceX rocket debris believed to have crashed into the moon
item.description: NASA scientists believe a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket segment crashed into the moon Wednesday. With 170 million pieces of space junk orbiting Earth, experts say a global strategy is urgently needed.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane, evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Floridians who pay $1,250 a year can get priority hurricane evacuations on a private plane
item.description: When the next hurricane heads toward Florida, some people won’t have to join the lines of traffic slowly snaking out of town. Instead, they will be swiftly flown out of state on a privately hired airplane.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man charged with organizing the 1996 killing of Tupac Shakur on trial
item.description: The man who prosecutors say orchestrated the 1996 killing of rap icon Tupac Shakur is scheduled to go to trial Monday, almost 30 years after the fatal drive-by shooting in Las Vegas.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Gene-edited beagles may offer a future option for people with dog allergies
item.description: Matt Walker couldn't pet a dog without sneezing — until he and other scientists used a gene editing technique to produce a hypoallergenic beagle named Bailey.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 17-year-old suspect arrested in Manatee County after fatal shooting of 2 teens: U.S. Marshals
item.description: The United States Marshals Service announced Wednesday morning the arrest of Keyan Rundell in Ellenton on two counts of second-degree murder.

item.description: Scientists have captured images of the sun’s surface in the finest detail yet
